sdlc_ignore_note: .gitignore does not list .sdlc/, but .git/info/exclude line 7 does (local-only, not shared via the repo); git status already hides .sdlc/ in this clone.

topology.sampling_mode: full (not sample-based: 20 top-level dirs, ~12.3k tracked files)

tier2b_reason: Primary stack is a React + Express TypeScript monorepo built on the Backstage framework; no pre-authored adapter matches (shipped: generic, nest, python).
test_command_source: package.json#scripts.test (backstage-cli repo test; yarn.lock present) + .claude/CLAUDE.md "Development Flow" (always pass a path; never run all tests)
env_keys_referenced_scope: git grep process.env.* in packages/, plugins/, scripts/ (names only); no os.environ/os.getenv/System.getenv hits

infra_hints.husky_pre_commit: yarn lint-staged (eslint --fix, prettier --write, catalog-info generation, sort-package-json)

regulated_repo_note: Only signal is SECURITY.md (an open-source vulnerability-disclosure policy). No HIPAA/PCI/SOC2/GDPR/compliance files or folders; CODEOWNERS names no security/compliance/privacy/legal teams. Likely a false positive, but the contract requires the warning.

off_limits_rationale.docs/releases/**: .claude/CLAUDE.md: never change release notes unless explicitly asked

policy_hints_from_project_instructions: Do not edit ESLint, Prettier or TypeScript config files unless asked (.eslintrc.js, tsconfig.json, .prettierignore).
Never run yarn build, yarn changesets version or yarn release.
New .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx files need an Apache 2.0 header with the current year; do not bump years on existing files.
Published-package changes under packages/ or plugins/ need changeset coverage in .changeset/ (edit files directly, never the changeset CLI).
report*.api.md files are generated by yarn build:api-reports; regenerate rather than hand-edit.
Type check only with yarn tsc at repo root, no options.
coexistence_notes: Cursor rules detected at .cursor/rules/ (backstage-project.mdc, tests/*.mdc) - untouched by default.
Claude Code project config at .claude/ (CLAUDE.md, settings.local.json, skills/) - untouched by default.
GitHub Copilot instructions at .github/copilot-instructions.md and AGENTS.md - untouched by default.
No .mcp.json, no Aider config, no repo-local routing-policy.yaml, no gemini*.yaml/json found.
.gitignore does not cover .sdlc/; it is excluded locally via .git/info/exclude, so git add -A in this clone will not pick it up (other clones would).
Husky pre-commit runs lint-staged (eslint --fix, prettier --write, catalog-info generation) on commit.
